_comment: If you control 3+ Seismic Surge tokens, +2{d}; if 6+, INSTEAD +4{d}; Guardwell. Modeled as base +2 (at 3+) plus an additional +2 (at 6+) so it totals +2 at 3-5 and +4 at 6+. Prior JSON gave +2 (3+) AND +4 (6+) as separate statics -> +6 at 6+ (wrong); and CONTROLS_TOKEN_TYPE ignored 'amount' (fired at 1+). Both now correct: amount honored + additive branches.

abilities._comment: Was a plain STATIC, which nothing dispatches, and MODIFY_DEFENSE_VALUE wrote combat.total_defense, which _resolve_damage recomputes from sum(card.defense) immediately before damage -- so the value was discarded even when something did set it. WHILE_STATIC on RECALC_DEFENSE with MODIFY_DEFENSE moves the DEFENDING CARD's own {d}, which is what survives into the total. The two tiers are exclusive -- 'INSTEAD +4' -- and were authored as two +2s that would have stacked to +4 at six tokens by accident and given +2 too many in between. Both printings also said +2; the second is +4.
